# Upsize Property Renovation Ltd

> Kitchen, bathroom, wet room and roofing contractor based in Peterborough, UK, working up to 40 miles across Cambridgeshire, Lincolnshire and the East Midlands, Monday to Saturday.

## Sectors
- Social housing: turnkey kitchen, bathroom and level-access wet room replacements in void and occupied homes, 5 working days per property, one team for every trade. Fixed basket pricing with variations to the client's schedule of rates. Works for main contractors, housing associations and councils.
- Commercial: kitchens, bathrooms, wet rooms, and flat and pitched roofing for commercial property.
- Residential: kitchens, bathrooms, wet rooms and roofing for homeowners, from roof repairs to full re-roofs.

## Key facts
- 240+ projects completed; 80+ roofs completed; 12+ years' multi-trade experience
- £5m public liability insurance; CSCS-carded and DBS-checked operatives
- Policies written to SSIP standards; PQQ completed; CHAS and Constructionline applications in progress (Q1 2027)
- Registered in England & Wales, company number 15856524

## Frequently asked questions
- **How much does a new roof cost in Peterborough?** As a guide, a full re-roof with concrete tiles costs around £4,500–£7,500 for a terraced house, £6,500–£10,500 for a 3-bed semi and £8,000–£13,000 for a detached house, including scaffolding and waste removal. We give you a fixed, written price after a free roof check.
- **How much does a roof repair cost?** Small repairs, such as replacing slipped or cracked tiles, usually cost £150–£400. Re-bedding a full ridge is typically £450–£1,200. We photograph the problem first, so you see exactly what needs fixing before you agree a price.
- **Should I repair or replace my roof?** If the timbers and most of the tiles are sound, a repair is usually better value. Replacement makes sense when repairs would cost more than about a quarter of a new roof, or when the covering has reached the end of its life. We always advise repair first where it genuinely works.
- **What are the signs I need a new roof?** Common signs are damp patches on ceilings, daylight showing in the loft, a sagging roof line, lots of slipped or cracked tiles, crumbling ridge mortar and heavy moss. One sign on its own often means a repair; several together usually point to a re-roof.
- **How long does it take to replace a roof?** Most houses take 3–8 working days, depending on size and access. A terraced house is often 3–5 days and a 3-bed semi 5–8 days. Scaffolding goes up first, and the roof is kept watertight at the end of every day.
- **How much does an EPDM rubber flat roof cost and how long does it last?** EPDM rubber roofing typically costs £80–£120 per m² fitted, so a garage or small extension roof is usually £1,200–£2,500. A correctly installed EPDM roof can last 30–50 years, much longer than traditional felt.
- **Do I need planning permission or building regulations to replace my roof?** Planning permission is not normally needed to replace a house roof like-for-like. Building regulations approval is usually needed if you re-roof more than a quarter of the roof area or change the insulation. We will tell you what applies to your roof before work starts.
- **Does home insurance cover roof leaks and storm damage?** Most home insurance covers sudden storm damage but not wear and tear or gradual leaks. Check your policy. We can provide dated photos and a written report of the damage to support your claim.
- **Do you offer free roof inspections in Peterborough?** Yes. We offer free roof checks across Peterborough and up to 40 miles around, with photos of what we find and a written quote. There is no obligation to go ahead.
- **Do you guarantee your roofing work?** Yes. Every roofing job comes with a written guarantee. The length depends on the work and materials, and is set out clearly in your quote.
- **Do you do commercial roofing?** Yes. We repair and replace flat and pitched roofs on commercial units, offices and managed property, including EPDM flat roofing, and can plan the work around your opening hours.
- **Do you install wet rooms and level-access showers?** Yes. We install wet rooms and level-access showers for social housing adaptations, commercial property and private homes, including non-slip flooring, shower seats and grab rails.
- **Do you fit kitchens and bathrooms for homeowners and businesses?** Yes. We supply and fit kitchens, bathrooms and wet rooms for homeowners, landlords and commercial clients, with experience installing Howdens and Symphony kitchens.
- **How long does a kitchen or bathroom installation take?** Most kitchen or bathroom replacements take around 5 working days. One Upsize team handles every trade, from strip-out to decoration, so there are no gaps waiting for other trades.
- **How long does a social housing kitchen or bathroom replacement take?** Five working days per property. One Upsize team covers every trade, from strip-out to decoration, in both void and occupied homes.
- **Do you work with main contractors, housing associations and councils?** Yes. We work on fixed basket pricing with variations to your schedule of rates. Our policies are written to SSIP standards and our PQQ is complete. CHAS and Constructionline applications are in progress for Q1 2027.
- **Are you insured and are your operatives vetted?** Yes. We carry £5m public liability insurance, and every operative is CSCS-carded and DBS-checked.
- **Which areas do you cover?** Peterborough and up to 40 miles around it, including Stamford, Spalding, Bourne, Market Deeping, Holbeach, Wisbech, March, Huntingdon, St Neots, Oakham, Corby, Kettering and Grantham.
- **Do you work on Saturdays?** Yes. We work Monday to Friday 7:30–19:00 and Saturday 8:00–16:00.
- **How do I get a quote?** Call 0800 193 9030, message us on WhatsApp or send the form below. We reply within one working day, and all quotes are free with no obligation.
